name: Your Mother Disgusts Me
source:
A yuri horror visual novel set in the heart of England. 

Three women - a mother, a daughter, and a stranger - take refuge in a shipping container during the apocalypse. They have to hash out their differences, lest they attract the attention of the deadly, disgusting parasites that have begun to infect humanity.

[Edited from [url=https://sirizchai.itch.io/ymdm-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部以英格兰市中心为背景的尤里恐怖视觉小说。

三个女人——一位母亲、一个女儿和一个陌生人——在世界末日期间在一个集装箱里避难。他们必须解决分歧，以免引起已经开始感染人类的​​致命、令人厌恶的寄生虫的注意。

[编辑自[url=https://sirizchai.itch.io/ymdm-demo]itch.io[/url]]
